AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#321 @ 8bc4de3aaf266616cc4d42f32ea4a0ed65931c4e — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

**A/B/C: 0/1/1.** Independent exact-head T3 package-editor audit paired with backend #629; no pushes, merges or production actions. [Candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/321)

### B — must fix

**B-321-1 — actual price-save failures still display raw/generic errors without the required recovery/reference path.** The updated save catch maps three floor codes, but all other failures fall through to `errorMessage(err, 'Please check your inputs and try again.')` (`CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx:205-228`), without status-aware network/session handling or a request reference/support route; `errorMessage` simply passes through the server/JS error and `errorCode` reads only `data.error`, not a machine `data.code`. This is the existing fallback inside the modified save flow, not a claim that this PR introduced it; the owner's explicit no-vague-error requirement applies to that user-facing path. [Save catch](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/8bc4de3aaf266616cc4d42f32ea4a0ed65931c4e/src/screens/coach/payments/CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx#L205-L228), [error extraction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/8bc4de3aaf266616cc4d42f32ea4a0ed65931c4e/src/types/common.ts#L37-L65).

Independent real-screen tests changed the price to $49 and pressed Save: a 500 carrying `request_id: sol321-reference` displayed only “Internal server error”; a network failure displayed only “Network Error,” with no working next step. Both regressions failed at this exact head; there is no reporting/reference handling in this catch. [Affected real screen](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/8bc4de3aaf266616cc4d42f32ea4a0ed65931c4e/src/screens/coach/payments/CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx#L172-L233).

Minimal fix: use a package-save error mapper that reads status and machine code/error; distinguish offline/timeout (connection plus Retry), ended session (sign in), known validation/ownership/locked cases (specific correction), and unknown/server failures (short request reference, working support route and Sentry reporting). Preserve the new floor messages and add real-screen failure tests rather than only success/domain-code mocks.

### C / boundaries

**C-321-1:** `packagePriceIssue` exempts any unchanged legacy cents regardless of a billing-interval change; it has no previous interval input. Align its grandfathering with the owner decision on backend C-629-1 so a new below-floor billing configuration is not silently treated as an unchanged offer. [Helper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/8bc4de3aaf266616cc4d42f32ea4a0ed65931c4e/src/utils/packagePrice.ts#L22-L38), [paired audit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/629)

The bounded floor helper and inline copy otherwise match the intended 1999/zero-one-time rule, save validation uses the same helper, unchanged legacy cents remain editable, and the three existing backend `error` floor codes receive the specific “Check the price” message. No auth/native/dependency changes occur in this four-file diff. Do not release free creation until backend #595/#629 actually admit zero through the HTTP DTO boundary; backend B-629-1 is reproduced separately. [Editor/helper diff](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/321), [backend audit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/629)

### Tests / exact-head CI

Through heavy.sh, `npx jest --runInBand --ci src/utils/__tests__/packagePrice.test.ts src/__tests__/CoachPackageEditScreen.lockPreview.test.tsx`: **2 suites / 15 tests passed**; real-screen below-floor save/domain-alert tests would fail on the earlier screen. Independent `src/__tests__/aud-sol3-price-errors.test.tsx -t 'AUD-SOL3 actionable'`: **2 failures**, preserved in `ops/reports/AUD-SOL3-321-{error-proof.log,price-errors.test.tsx}`. [Candidate tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/8bc4de3aaf266616cc4d42f32ea4a0ed65931c4e/src/__tests__/CoachPackageEditScreen.lockPreview.test.tsx#L175-L245)

All four exact-head checks succeeded. No device or real checkout was performed; merge the complete backend free contract first, then re-audit the integrated pair. [Typecheck/lint/test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/36935381026/job/110614292862), [CodeQL](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/36935381020).

Fix round 3 (lane B-FEE-R3) at a9b1f49d. Merged main 0b7f197f cleanly (f3c966e).

| Finding | Disposition | Change | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-321-1 | Fixed | New `src/utils/packageSaveFailure.ts`. Status plus machine code (`code`, then `error`) map to a specific message with a working action: Try again (offline/timeout/5xx), Sign in (401), Open billing (403 plan codes), Back to packages (403/404/archived), the price or field fix (400 floor codes / PACKAGE_INVALID), and the locked copy (409). Unknown failures show reference `XXXXXXXX` from `request_id` (body, then `x-request-id`, then the sent id), offer Contact support (SupportInbox), and send a sanitised Sentry event `package_save_<mode>_failed` `{flow, mode, status, code, reference}`. The message stays inline, so the reference survives the dialog. | `src/__tests__/CoachPackageEditScreen.lockPreview.test.tsx` real screen: 500 with `request_id: "sol321-reference"` → "quote reference SOL321RE", buttons Try again / Contact support / Close, Sentry context exact, Try again re-saves and succeeds; network error → No connection + Try again, no Sentry; timeout; 401; 403; 404; `code`-only price refusal; 4 no-generic-copy cases. `src/utils/__tests__/packageSaveFailure.test.ts`: 19-case table, reference order, privacy. |
| C-321-1 | Fixed | `packagePriceIssue(cents, interval, saved)`: grandfathered only while price and interval are unchanged (matches backend #629 C-629-1). | `packagePrice.test.ts` C-321-1 case; screen "cannot change its billing interval without meeting the floor" |

Local: `npx jest --runInBand src/utils/__tests__/packageSaveFailure.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/packagePrice.test.ts src/__tests__/CoachPackageEditScreen.lockPreview.test.tsx` → 3 suites, 34 passed. `npx tsc --noEmit` → 0. eslint changed files → 0 errors (1 pre-existing warning). Ready for a fresh audit; the builder does not audit its own change.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#321 @ a9b1f49d7417c2e40dc6405f79f15f3614076a20 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

**Opus A/B/C: 0/2/1. Full T3 audit at the live head. All findings are in this one pass.** The head is fix round 3 (a9b1f49) on a clean merge of main 0b7f197f (f3c966e). It goes with backend #629 @ 858eb40b, which I audited at the same time (REQUEST CHANGES).

### Prior findings
- **B-321-1 closed.** `src/utils/packageSaveFailure.ts` picks the failure from the HTTP status plus the machine code (`code`, then `error`). Each case has a next action that works: Try again, Sign in, Open billing (`Billing`), Back to packages (`CoachPackagesList`), or the price or field fix. All of these routes are in the coach SettingsStack (`CoachNavigator.tsx:406,426,454`). An unknown failure shows a short reference from `request_id` and Contact support (`SupportInbox`). It also sends a sanitised Sentry event `package_save_<mode>_failed` with only `{flow, mode, status, code, reference}`. Retry runs the latest form state through `handleSaveRef`.
- **C-321-1 closed.** `packagePriceIssue(cents, interval, saved)` keeps a pre-floor price only while both the price and the billing interval are unchanged.

### B: must fix
- **B-321-2: no package can be created from the app.** `toBackendCreate` (`src/api/packagesApi.ts:405-420`) sends `currency` only if the input has one (`:413`), and the editor never sets it. Backend `CreatePackageDto.currency` is required (`packages.dto.ts:26-28`), and the production pipe uses `forbidNonWhitelisted`. My backend probe at #629 858eb40b posted the exact bodies this function builds:
  - $19.99 one-time
  - $19.99 monthly
  - $0 free

  **All three get 400 "currency must be one of the following values: usd, gbp, eur, aud, cad".** With this PR the coach sees that sentence under "Check the package details", and the editor has no currency field to fix. The free and $19.99 create flows this PR adds therefore cannot finish against the real backend. The screen tests mock the API, so they cannot catch this.

  **Fix:** in `toBackendCreate`, send `currency: input.currency ?? 'usd'`. **Test:** a contract test that `toBackendCreate` output for each billing option contains every field `CreatePackageDto` requires (`name`, `amount_cents`, `currency`, `billing_type`) and nothing it would reject. The backend side is C-629-2 on #629.
- **B-321-3: a billing change in edit mode is dropped while the app says "Changes saved".** The Billing control stays enabled when editing (`CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx:454`). `toBackendUpdate` (`packagesApi.ts:432-439`) never sends a billing field; its TODO at `:428` says the backend does not accept them, but `UpdatePackageDto` now does (`billing_type`, `billing_interval`, `billing_interval_count`). The coach then sees "Package updated / Changes saved" (`:228`) while billing on the server is unchanged.

  This PR's C-321-1 rule now checks billing changes that never reach the server. On a recurring package, choosing One-time and $0 sends only `amount_cents: 0`. The backend answers "Free packages are one-time. Switch the package to one-time", which the coach has already done, so it loops.

  **Fix (pick one):**
  - Send the billing fields, mapping one-time to `billing_type:'one_time', billing_interval:null`. This needs backend B-629-4.
  - Or lock Billing in edit mode with copy such as "Billing is set when the package is created. Create a new package to change it."

  **Test:** an edit-mode billing change either appears in the PATCH body, or the control is disabled with that copy.

### C
- **C-321-2:** the `invalid` case passes the backend's DTO text through `backendMessage` (`packageSaveFailure.ts`, 400 branch). Once B-321-2 is fixed the editor cannot produce a DTO error, but if one occurs the coach sees field names such as `amount_cents`. **Fix:** map a 400 with no `code` to the fallback copy and keep the backend text out of the UI.

### Release blocker outside this diff (not counted; route to a lane)
- **The app has no way to publish a package.** Nothing under `src/` calls `POST /v1/coach/packages/:id/publish`. Backend `create()` saves every package as a draft (`published_at: null`), and checkout refuses drafts (`checkout.service.ts:139,463`). `fromBackend` maps a draft to `status: 'active'`, so the coach believes it is on sale. Once B-321-2 is fixed, an app-created package can be saved and shared but not bought.

  **Needed:** Publish and Unpublish controls, a draft or live status from `published_at`, and publish-error mapping (PACKAGE_PRICE_BELOW_MINIMUM and PACKAGE_ARCHIVED on publish).

### Evidence at a9b1f49d
- CI at this head is all green: Typecheck, lint, test; CodeQL; Analyze (actions, javascript-typescript).
- The backend contract probe is saved at `ops/aud-opus-110/probe_629_mobile_bodies.spec.ts`. It was run against backend #629 858eb40b with the production ValidationPipe and HttpExceptionFilter.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#321 @ 4295fc793fc23bfd684a63a2bdc8bd93efdc9b7e — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

**This is the T3 fix-round 4 re-audit; Opus is the single lens. Opus A/B/C: 0/2/4.**

Fix round 4 is one commit, 4295fc7, on top of a9b1f49 (f3c966e was already proven a pure merge). It has no fix-round comment and no round-4 rows in the body table, so I audited the commit itself. All of my round-3 findings are closed, and so is the out-of-diff publish blocker. The two new B findings are both in the editor's save and publish path:
- B-321-4 is older code that I missed at a9b1f49d. I own that miss.
- B-321-5 is new in this round.

### Prior findings: closed (code plus test)
- **B-321-2 (no create possible): closed.**
  - **Code:** `toBackendCreate` always sends `currency` in lower case and defaults it to `usd` (`src/api/packagesApi.ts:424`).
  - **Tests:** `packagesBackendContract.test.ts` checks every billing option against the `CreatePackageDto` whitelist, and checks that the POST the editor sends carries `currency`.
  - **Against the real backend:** I sent the exact bodies to backend #629 @ d134f012, using the production pipe and filter. The one-time, monthly, quarterly (`month` x3), yearly and free $0 creates all returned 201 ([#629 verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/629#issuecomment-5955565209)).
- **B-321-3 (billing edits dropped): closed.**
  - **Code:**
    - The editor sends billing only when it changed (`CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx:228-232`).
    - `toBackendUpdate` maps One-time to `billing_type:'one_time', billing_interval:null`.
    - Quarterly maps to `month` x3.
  - **Backend probe:** recurring $25 to one-time free in one PATCH returned 200, and the switch back to monthly also returned 200.
  - **Tests:** the screen test "an edit-mode billing change reaches the PATCH body" and the name-only control.
- **C-321-2 (DTO text in the UI): closed as scoped.** A 400 without `PACKAGE_INVALID` now shows `INVALID_FALLBACK`. The coded case is covered under C-321-3.
- **Publish blocker (out of diff at a9b1f49d): closed.**
  - `coachPackagesApi.publish` / `unpublish` exist.
  - `statusOf` reads `published_at`, so a draft shows as Draft.
  - The editor has a Publish / Unpublish control, and the list screen labels drafts.
  - Publish failures are mapped: `PACKAGE_PRICE_BELOW_MINIMUM` shows "Check the price" with the floor copy, and `PACKAGE_ARCHIVED` is handled.
  - The `is_active` concern is not reachable: the editor never sends `status`.

### B: must fix
- **B-321-4: Trial days and Features are thrown away, but the app says "Changes saved".**
  - **What happens:** the editor shows "Trial days (optional)" and "Features (one per line)" (`CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx:530-551`), and the buyer preview shows them as what clients will see (`:372-392`). Neither field is ever sent: see the `TODO(backend)` comments at `packagesApi.ts:419,439,453`. The backend has no trial or features column for packages, and checkout has no package trial.
  - **Probe** (`src/__tests__/auditProbe321Screen.test.tsx`, local only, real screen and real `toBackendUpdate`): typing 7 trial days and saving produces the body `{"name":…,"description":…,"amount_cents":9900}` with no trial. The alert still says "Package updated / Changes saved."
  - **Why it matters:** a coach who promises a 7-day trial has clients charged on day one. This is the same class as B-321-3, and the fallback copy even says "Check the price, billing and trial days".
  - **Minimal fix:**
    - Remove both inputs, and their part of the preview, until the backend stores them. Change the fallback copy to match.
    - Or, as an operator decision, have the backend add the columns and the checkout trial (T4), then send them.
  - **Test:** a contract test that every editable input on the screen reaches the request body. If an input is not sent, it must not be rendered.
- **B-321-5: Publish ignores unsaved edits.**
  - **What happens:** `handlePublishToggle` publishes the saved row (`:268-300`). The button is disabled only while publishing (`:619`), and there is no dirty check.
  - **Probe:** with a draft saved at $19.99, I typed $50.00 and tapped Publish package.
    - `update` was called 0 times and `publish` once.
    - The alert said "Package published / Clients can now buy this package."
    - The form still showed 50.00.
  - So the package goes on sale at a price the screen does not show.
  - **Minimal fix:**
    - When the form differs from `original`, Publish saves first and then publishes.
    - Or disable Publish with the copy "Save your changes before you publish."
  - **Test:** after a price edit, Publish either calls `update` before `publish`, or is disabled with that copy.

### C
- **C-321-3:** a `PACKAGE_INVALID` body is shown word for word (`packageSaveFailure.ts:273`). The service's own `PACKAGE_INVALID` strings are developer text. Probe on publish: "recurring packages require interval = week | month | year". The filter text names API fields (backend C-629-4). **Fix:** use app copy for `PACKAGE_INVALID`, or allow-list the phrases written for coaches.
- **C-321-4:** publish and unpublish failures still use save titles: "Could not save the package" (`:286`) and "Too many saves" (`:257`). Probe: a publish 500 returns "Could not save the package / The package is not on sale yet…". **Fix:** choose the title by mode.
- **C-321-5:** a weekly backend package reads as Monthly (`packagesApi.ts:358`). The list and editor then show the wrong cadence, and keeping "Monthly" keeps it weekly. **Fix:** add `weekly` as a read-only label, or show "Weekly (change it on the web)".
- **C-321-6:** the archived banner says "Restore it by setting status back to Active in the form below" (`CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx:448`). There is no status control, and the backend refuses edits to archived packages; the `PACKAGE_ARCHIVED` copy says to create a new package. This banner predates the PR, but it is on this screen. **Fix:** "This package is archived. It cannot be sold or changed. Create a new package instead."
- **Process (not counted):** the PR body has no fix-round rows for round 4 (B-321-2, B-321-3, C-321-2, publish), and there is no fix-round comment.

### Evidence
- **Local**, with the shared mobile deps (package.json and lock identical) and heavy.sh: `env CI=true npx jest --runInBand` on the contract, save-failure, price and editor-screen suites plus my probe. Result: 5 suites, 60 tests passed. A second run of the screen probe gave 2 of 2 passed.
- **CI at this head:** Typecheck, lint, test; Analyze (javascript-typescript); and Analyze (actions) are all SUCCESS, and CodeQL is SUCCESS.
- **Merge state:** the head is behind main e3986e89 (#313). Merge-tree is clean (f20e8be2), and #313 touches no package files.
- **Merge order:** backend #629 must merge first, because one-time edits need its explicit-null handling.

No push, merge or production action.

Fix round 5 (lane B-FEE-R5) at `7322bbf`. Merged mobile main e3986e89 (#313) with merge commit bbb02d1 (clean). This closes the Opus REQUEST CHANGES (0/2/4) at 4295fc79.

| Finding | Disposition | Change | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-321-4 | Fixed | The Trial days and Features inputs and their preview parts are removed (the backend stores neither). Every remaining input reaches the request. | screen "B-321-4 ..." |
| B-321-5 | Fixed | Publish is disabled with "Save your changes before you publish." while the form has unsaved edits. | screen "B-321-5 ..." |
| C-321-3 / C-629-4 | Fixed | `PACKAGE_INVALID` never shows API text. The field it is about picks plain copy. | unit (7 backend strings) + screen |
| C-321-4 | Fixed | Failure titles follow the action (create / save / publish / unpublish). | unit + screen |
| C-321-5 | Fixed | Weekly is a read-only interval. It reads and saves as `week`. | screen + mapper |
| C-321-6 | Fixed | New archived banner copy. | screen |
| Process | Fixed | Body now has rows for round 4 and round 5. | - |

The $19.99-minimum-or-free rule is unchanged and matches merged backend #629: 1999 cents or more, or exactly 0 on a one-time package. The floor codes show #629's copy.

Local runs, all through heavy.sh:
- jest: 6 suites passed.
- `tsc --noEmit`: 0 errors.
- eslint: 0 errors.

Ready for a fresh audit. The builder does not audit its own change.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#321 @ 7322bbff3772cf28c96db61a2f405904ccf9edfb — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Second Opus lens on fix round 5. The delta from the last Opus audit at `4295fc79` is the merge commit `bbb02d1` (main `e3986e89`, #313) plus `7322bbf`. The merge is pure: `git merge-tree --write-tree 4295fc79 e3986e89` gives `f20e8be2`, which is the committed tree. The head is up to date with main. I read every prior AUDIT comment, the fix-round 5 comment and the body table.

Counts: A 0, B 1, C 1.

Operator ruling (not a finding): the Trial days and Features inputs are gone because the backend stores neither. I confirmed that no fake path can reach them.

### Prior findings: all closed (code and test)
- **B-321-4: closed.**
  - The inputs and their preview parts are removed (`CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx:144-146`). The preview now sends `trialDays: null, features: []` (`:387-388`).
  - The fallback copy no longer mentions trial days (`packageSaveFailure.ts:105-107`).
  - Test: "B-321-4: no trial days or features inputs; every input on the screen reaches the PATCH body".
- **B-321-5: closed.**
  - `unsavedChanges` compares name, description, price and billing against `original`.
  - When the form has edits, Publish is disabled and the helper line says "Save your changes before you publish." A guarded early return in `handlePublishToggle` covers the same case (`:267-274`, `:585-603`).
  - Test: "B-321-5: … after saving it publishes".
- **C-321-3: closed.** `plainPackageInvalidMessage` turns a `PACKAGE_INVALID` text into plain app copy for the field it names (name, price, billing, currency, description), and falls back otherwise. The 120-character name limit matches the backend `CreatePackageDto` `@MaxLength(120)`.
- **C-321-4: closed.** Titles now follow the action: create, save, publish, unpublish, and "Too many tries".
- **C-321-5: closed.** `weekly` maps both ways (`week`). It is read-only, keeps the row's interval count, and the buyer surface shows "week" and the list shows "wk".
- **C-321-6: closed.** The archived banner copy is replaced.

### B: must fix
- **B-321-6: commit `7322bbf` adds a `node_modules` symlink to the repo, and the required check "Typecheck, lint, test" is red at this head.**
  - **What was committed:** `git ls-tree 7322bbf node_modules` shows `120000 … node_modules`, a symlink pointing at an absolute local path outside the repo (`…/deps/mobile/node_modules`).
  - **Why `.gitignore` did not stop it:** `.gitignore` has `node_modules/` with a trailing slash, which matches directories only.
  - **What breaks:**
    - On CI, after `npm ci` creates a real `node_modules/`, the Vendor-name guard reads every tracked file. It fails with `EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory, read` (`scripts/vendor-name-guard.mjs:85`, run 37042214960).
    - I reproduced the same crash locally at this head.
    - Any clone gets a dangling symlink where its `node_modules` directory should be.
  - **Minimal fix:**
    - `git rm --cached node_modules`, and change the ignore entry to `node_modules` (no trailing slash) so a symlink is ignored too.
    - Then re-run CI until "Typecheck, lint, test" is green at the new head.
    - Optionally, make the vendor guard skip symlinks and directories from `git ls-files` (`lstatSync(file).isFile()`).

### C
- **C-321-7: price copy offers $0 for a recurring package.** The `PACKAGE_INVALID` price message (`packageSaveFailure.ts`, `plainPackageInvalidMessage`) always says "or 0 to make it free". Under #629, free means exactly $0 on a one-time package only. **Fix:** say "or 0 to make it free" only when the package is one-time. For recurring, say "Recurring packages start at $19.99."

### Evidence
- **Local run** (`heavy.sh`, `CI=true npx jest --runInBand`): `CoachPackageEditScreen.lockPreview`, `packageSaveFailure`, `packagesBackendContract` and `PackageDetailSurface.preview`. 4 suites, 68 tests, all passed.
- **CI at `7322bbf`:**
  - Typecheck, lint, test: **FAILURE** (Vendor-name guard step, caused by the committed symlink).
  - Analyze (javascript-typescript): SUCCESS.
  - Analyze (actions): SUCCESS.
  - CodeQL: SUCCESS.
- **Approval path:** once B-321-6 is fixed and CI is green, nothing else blocks approval on this lens.
